decisions.reason: Future locations being addable without redesign does not change the current homepage location-selection and routing behavior, which already has its own same-message update.
The expansion and reusable-template decision does not alter domain mapping; the new master domain is already represented by a separate same-message Event.
Dedicated, consistently designed location pages remain compatible with each location having its own Wix website and do not necessarily change that architecture.
Reusable location-page design and future expansion do not change the separate-Wix-account requirement.
This Requirement already records a shared layout template across location sites, and its same-message Event separately captures the newly specified visual style without leaving stale state.
The existing same-message Event already records consistent Shatter House branding across location sites, so no additional propagated modification is required.
The future-location template strategy does not change which legacy content or images are reused for the migration task.
Ease of adding future locations does not alter the mobile-friendly design requirement, which is independently established by the same source message.
Consistent reusable location-page design does not change the requirement that each location maintain separate analytics, revenue, sales, and reporting.
The future expansion constraint does not change the master homepage's specified information sections or its information goal.
A reusable design and branding template does not modify the existing rule that packages and pricing remain consistent across location websites.
Future location-page expansion and visual consistency do not alter the separate payment setup and payout-isolation requirement.
